our_title: 59c9a31c bases the uninitialized label pointer of non-root processes in dorderSave
ran: mpirun --oversubscribe -np 3 $INFRA/asan/bin/dgord lbl.grf ord.out -T tre.out (pristine 7.0.18): 'dorder_io.c:144:12: runtime error: applying non-zero offset 18446744073709551612 to null pointer' on both non-root ranks (repro/DMO-02/run_7018_pristine_asan.txt); series: no report, identical output.
read_only: dorder_io.c:113-116: only permtab is set to NULL before the root-only allocation, so on non-root processes vlbltax is indeterminate when :144 offsets it (the ASan -O0 stack slot happened to hold 0; -ftrivial-auto-var-init=pattern hides it).
evidence: dorder_io.c:115 '  permtab       = NULL;' and :144 '   vlbltax -= grafptr->baseval;                  /* Base label array since displacement array is based */' (3-space indent, also :146).

fix_options.label: A: initialize to NULL and base on the root only
fix_options.summary: in 0003 (with the dorderSaveTree2 fix); also restores the 2-space indent

upstream_fix_review.details: Introduced by the fix: the basing line runs on every process, and the non-root pointer was never initialized.
upstream_fix_review.compared_with_ours: Our 7.0.17 0005 had 'permtab = vlbltax = NULL' and 'if (vlbltax != NULL)'.

our_title: 2d1b7e39 labels its two new load tests with size messages, one with the sequential name
ran: DMO-12 proof B ($WORK/dbgold, pristine 7.0.18 DEBUG_ALL with the 7.0.17 store): the local-load mismatch prints '(r): ERROR: vgraphCheck: invalid local part sizes' on all 3 ranks (repro/DMO-12/proof_7018.txt).
read_only: vdgraph_check.c:106-109 (load sum test with message 'vdgraphCheck: invalid local size sum', identical to the size sum message at :118) and header line 45 'to   : 31 oct 2023'.
evidence: vdgraph_check.c:108 'errorPrint ("vdgraphCheck: invalid local size sum");' (tests complocload) and :246 'errorPrint ("vgraphCheck: invalid local part sizes");' (tests complocload).

fix_options.label: A: proper messages
fix_options.summary: in 0007 ('invalid local load sum', 'vdgraphCheck: invalid local part loads'; date bumped to 02 nov 2026)

upstream_fix_review.details: Copied messages make a load inconsistency look like a size inconsistency of the sequential routine.
upstream_fix_review.compared_with_ours: Our 7.0.17 0003 used 'vdgraphCheck: invalid local part loads'.
